name: cik
description: 10-digit zero-padded SEC Central Index Key

name: cik_int
description: Integer SEC Central Index Key

name: entity_name
description: SEC registrant entity name

name: is_corpus_cik
description: True if registrant appears in the Form S-1 / SPAC corpus

name: taxonomy
description: XBRL taxonomy namespace (us-gaap, dei, spac, ffd, ifrs-full, srt)

name: concept
description: XBRL concept tag name

name: label
description: Human-readable XBRL concept label

name: unit
description: Unit of measure (USD, shares, USD/shares, pure, etc.)

name: val
description: Numeric XBRL fact value

name: val_str
description: Non-numeric XBRL fact value when text

name: start_date
description: Reporting period start date (NULL for instant facts)

name: end_date
description: Reporting period end date or instant date

name: duration_days
description: Calendar days between start_date and end_date (NULL for instant facts)

name: is_instant
description: True for balance-sheet / point-in-time facts without a start_date

name: filed
description: SEC EDGAR filing date

name: fy
description: Fiscal year reported

name: fp
description: Fiscal period (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4)

name: form
description: SEC form type (10-K, 10-Q, S-1, S-1/A, 8-K, 20-F, etc.)

name: frame
description: SEC calendarized reporting frame (e.g. CY2026Q3I, CY2025)

name: accn
description: SEC accession number
